homepage.subtitle.message: An embedded wearable system based on LVGL and JerryScript, designed for resource-constrained hardware to deliver smooth smartwatch experiences.

homepage.layoutDescription.message: ElenixOS build, script engine, and development tools documentation site.

homepage.features.scriptDriven.descripti.message: ElenixOS adopts a script-driven application model, with UI and interaction logic defined by JavaScript, and rendering and scheduling handled by native code.

homepage.features.runtime.description.message: The graphics stack is powered by LVGL, and watchfaces and applications run uniformly on the JerryScript engine, ensuring consistent runtime behavior.

homepage.features.portable.description.message: Clear abstraction layers and unified API make ElenixOS easier to migrate and reuse across different MCUs and hardware platforms.

homepage.features.ux.description.message: Drawing inspiration from Apple Watch's interaction philosophy, ElenixOS emphasizes gesture flows, animation continuity, and information hierarchy for embedded interfaces.

homepage.features.heading.message: Built for smartwatches, designed for developers

homepage.codeCard.footer.message: WASM for ElenixOS is under development, and the code below has been verified on real hardware.

homepage.arch.heading.message: Six-layer architecture, cleanly decoupled from hardware to application

homepage.arch.subtitle.message: Each layer has clear responsibilities, providing a unified API upward and adapting to different hardware platforms downward.

homepage.arch.flowNote.message: Each app has its own isolated Realm environment. SPM manages the lifecycle, and SNI provides a unified API bridge.

homepage.why.subtitle.message: An open system purpose-built for wearables, balancing extreme performance with development efficiency.

homepage.why.script.desc.message: Write UI and interaction logic in JavaScript, with hot updates without recompiling firmware. Watchfaces and apps share the same script runtime and API system, reducing learning costs and increasing consistency.

homepage.why.resource.desc.message: JerryScript is designed for low-memory devices, and LVGL renders efficiently. The system is deeply optimized to run smoothly on typical smartwatch MCUs with extremely low RAM usage.

homepage.why.portable.title.message: Highly Portable, Write Once & Reuse Across Platforms

homepage.why.portable.desc.message: Six-layer abstraction and unified device interfaces — porting to a new MCU only requires driver layer adaptation, with zero changes to upper-layer application code, drastically reducing cross-platform migration costs.

homepage.why.ux.desc.message: UI and interaction style deeply reference Apple Watch, emphasizing animation continuity, gesture fluidity, and interface hierarchy. Combined with the LVGL animation system and event mechanism, it delivers a near-native smartwatch experience on embedded platforms.

homepage.tech.lvgl.desc.message: Lightweight embedded graphics library with rich UI controls and animation capabilities, powering all interface rendering.

homepage.tech.jerry.desc.message: A JavaScript engine designed for IoT and embedded devices, providing a complete ES5.1 execution environment with minimal memory footprint.
